verdict.rationale: ZCode is an AI coding workbench, so a team-shared workspace built from docs and repos is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only shows `--workspace` pointing the web UI at a single local project directory, plus token-protected LAN access to that UI. That is an adjacent access control, not a documented shared team workspace that combines docs and repos as a common source of truth, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can create a shared workspace from my docs and repos as a common source of truth for the team
